acceptance.referencePolicy: Chromium provides screen and print reference observations, not a universal oracle. OfficeIMO screen-to-page is compared with the completed OfficeIMO screen display list. Every selected case and capability must pass each applicable intent; intentional sheet, clipping, and font differences are admitted only through explicit bounded criteria.

screen.rationale: Chromium screen geometry and pixels are the reference; bounded text, font-rasterization, and full-page extent differences are admitted explicitly.

print.rationale: Chromium print-to-PDF is the reference; centered page comparison admits bounded raster-edge and font differences.

screenToPage.rationale: Fixed-canvas pages must reproduce the completed OfficeIMO screen display list within the declared horizontal clipping and final-page padding bounds.

visualInspection.method: 72dpi Poppler rasterization; all-page montages for every owned PDF lane and native print.
observations: Default print12 versus native4 remains unqualified; inset header and mostly empty page12.
Fit1200 lanes retain two gallery columns and four pages; header/card labels and footer typography differ from native.
Zero-margin/browser-UA/screen-media lanes retain narrow gallery and ten pages; fixed header overlays continuation content.
Snapshot lanes retain12 slices and footer on final slice; narrow responsive layout differs from frozen browser screen.

scope: Clean-source macOS H4 and NASA replay; does not qualify other frozen pages, unfamiliar-page budgets, editable targets or Windows/Linux.
